scope: Current public tree, all six reachable historical commit snapshots, commit identity headers, and locally authored workflow/review records. Course/research attribution and dependency licenses are scholarly material, not the owner profile.
numeric_scan_false_positives: A year-shaped number occurred only in JSON byte-count fields; it was not a biographical datum.
email_addresses: preserved byte for byte in commit headers; allowed in files
commit_dates_messages_and_file_trees: preserved; only display names and consequent parent identifiers rewritten
functional_repository_urls: retained; hosting under an account necessarily exposes its URL owner
boundary: Reachable repository content and metadata were audited. This does not certify deletion from third-party clones, unreachable server objects, old workflow logs, or cached GitHub commit views.
